plan.name: Use Toaster to Heat Mug (if applicable)
plan.strategy: Locate a mug, attempt to heat it in the toaster (if possible), and place it in the coffeemachine.
steps: Find a mug in one of the cabinets, drawers, or on the countertops.
Take the mug to the toaster.
Attempt to heat the mug in the toaster. If the toaster is not suitable for heating mugs, find an alternative method (e.g., microwave or stove burner).
Once the mug is heated, remove it from the toaster.
Place the heated mug into the coffeemachine.
